d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how a Kenyan High Court judge has ruled that the government breached constitutional rules on public participation, transparency, and access to information by approving a US-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base without consulting citizens. Justice Patricia Nyaundi ordered all work and operations at the site halted until the government discloses the full US agreements, safety and biosafety assessments, and isolation protocols within 45 days.
